lastResponse.text: Good question. Bring any ID, your disconnect notice, and any utility account info if you have it, but don’t wait to gather paperwork. Call 5 4 1, 4 8 8, 6 0 0 4 now and say you need same-day urgent help and no car. Ask them exactly what to bring so you keep your spot. If you feel unsafe at any point tonight, call 9 1 1 immediately.
